title: Output of the prompt-asset agent: an asset's texts (image, sound) or a poster's prompt
description: Two variants. Sound (`sfx` asset): `dureeSecondes` required, `methode` generation, no `sources`. Image (asset image or poster): no `dureeSecondes`.

reflexion.description: (French) Your draft, NEVER shown to the user, in two to four short lines, BEFORE writing the prompt: (1) what the canonical description says, to be kept; (2) what is missing and the precise choice you make; (3) what you add to reach the length.

raisonMethode.description: (French) One sentence: a sound generated by Stable Audio.

promptGeneration.description: (English) One or two sentences describing the sound (Stable Audio 3). No negation, no voice, no music, no visual term, no duration.

dureeSecondes.description: Sound duration in whole seconds. Impact 1–3, action 3–6, ambience 6–15; 15 at most unless a reason is given in `remarques`. Never written in the prompt.

remarques.description: Points to raise: voice or music requested (`voix-ou-musique`), duration above 15 s or loop (`autre`), description too vague.

reflexion.description: (French) Your draft, NEVER shown to the user, in two to four short lines, BEFORE writing the prompt: (1) what the canonical description and the brief say, to be kept word for word (for a poster: the one image you choose and the character's traits); (2) what is missing or hesitant (an "or", an absent trait) and the precise choice you make; (3) the details you add to reach the length the guide asks (40 to 100 words, more for a character).

methode.description: Recommended method. `edition` has an image 1, the target of the modification (usually the asset's starting image; for a poster, the main character's image).

sources.description: Edit only: codes of the assets whose image is supplied to the workflow, in order. The first is the target of the modification (by default the starting image), the next ones are references. Three at most. Omit for a generation.

promptGeneration.description: (English) Krea 2 prose (generation) or Qwen imperative instructions, one per line (edit). No style, no label. A poster ends with its exact final line (title rule).

remarques.description: Points to raise: requested variants, absence or change of viewpoint, dependency on an unproduced starting image, description too vague, duplicates; for a poster: vague summary, missing character image, title against tone.
